en.t: The Sutra on Contemplating the Mind Ground says:

units.source_text: 一切众生轮转五道，经百千劫，

en.t: All living beings revolve through the five paths for hundreds of thousands of kalpas,

units.source_text: 多次轮回转世之中，可能在何处又互成父母，

en.t: and in the course of many cycles of rebirth, they may somewhere become one another's parents again,
so all men in the human world are loving fathers,

units.source_text: 人世间的女子均悲母也。

en.t: and all women in the human world are compassionate mothers.
